record.name: Jedi
record.narrative: The Jedi background represents a life dedicated to the Force and the ancient traditions of the Jedi Order. Whether you were a Padawan who survived Order 66, a youngling who escaped the Temple's destruction, or were trained by a surviving Jedi Master, you carry the weight of the Order's legacy and the hope for its restoration. Your training in the Force, diplomacy, and combat makes you both a formidable ally and a target for those who fear or hate the Jedi.
record.flavor_text: 'The Force will be with you, always.' - Obi-Wan Kenobi
record.cultural_significance: Jedi are universally recognized as symbols of peace, justice, and the mystical power of the Force. During the Republic era, they were respected peacekeepers and diplomats. During the Empire era, they became hunted fugitives, their very existence a threat to Imperial control. In the post-Empire era, they represent hope for the restoration of balance and justice in the galaxy.
record.description: You were a member of the Jedi Order, a guardian of peace and justice in the galaxy. Whether you survived Order 66, were a youngling who escaped, or were trained by a surviving Jedi, you carry the legacy of the Order with you. Your training in the Force, diplomacy, and combat makes you a formidable ally and a target for the Empire.
record.life_experience: Life as a Jedi is one of constant training, meditation, and service. From early childhood, Jedi younglings are taught to control their emotions, master the Force, and serve the greater good. They learn diplomacy, combat, and the ancient wisdom of the Order. Many Jedi spend years as Padawans under the guidance of a Master, learning through experience and example. The life is one of sacrifice, discipline, and unwavering commitment to the light side of the Force.

llm_guidance.cultural_impact: Jedi represent the pinnacle of Force mastery and moral discipline. They are symbols of hope, justice, and the power of the light side. Throughout the galaxy, the sight of a Jedi inspires awe and respect, though during the Empire era it also inspired fear. The Jedi philosophy of peace, knowledge, and serenity has influenced countless cultures and individuals.
llm_guidance.social_standing: During the Republic era, Jedi were highly respected as peacekeepers and diplomats. During the Empire era, they were hunted fugitives with bounties on their heads. In the post-Empire era, they are symbols of hope and resistance, though their numbers are few and their influence limited.

feature.name: Padawan
feature.description: You have a master who taught you the ways of the Force. You know where to find them, or where they were last seen. Your master can provide guidance, training, or assistance when you need it most. Additionally, you have access to hidden Jedi safe houses and contacts throughout the galaxy.

parameters.description: Access to Jedi master for guidance and training

parameters.effect_description: Knowledge of hidden Jedi safe houses and contacts throughout the galaxy

traits: I use long words in an attempt to sound smart.
I am serene, even in the face of disaster.
I am fiercely protective of my friends.
I am incredibly slow to trust.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation.
I use multisyllabic words that others don't understand.
I have a strong sense of fair play.
I am haunted by memories of war.
ideals: Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge.
Peace. I will not be the one to draw my weapon first.
Justice. I bring criminals to justice.
Fairness. I never kill a target who has surrendered.
Power. I will do whatever it takes to become powerful.
bonds: I am searching for my former master.
I am protecting a secret that could endanger the galaxy.
I am the last of my line, and I must not fail.
I'm on the run from a crime lord I crossed.
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
flaws: I am overly critical of others' flaws.
I am haunted by visions of the future.
My pride sometimes gets the better of me.
I can't resist a pretty face.
When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between my friends and my mission, I'll choose my mission.

Their expression is serene and wise, reflecting years of training and meditation. The background shows a peaceful temple or natural setting, with soft lighting that suggests the mystical nature of the Force. The mood is contemplative and noble, representing the Jedi's commitment to balance and justice.
